oracle.description: A guest receiving HTTP 200 with the exact private record violates the fixture authorization invariant; HTTP 403 with DENIED is the declared negative case. Both runs must also preserve the admin request: the exact private record must remain available to admin.

entrypoint.description: Launch the normal server binary, then send a loopback guest HTTP GET through its listener and registered ServeMux.

resolutions.rationale: The external ServeMux.HandleFunc registration implementation is not graphed. The guest GET through the normal listener reaching the declared handler marker evidences this registration path for this fixture request only; arbitrary registration or deployment behavior stays unproven.
The external fmt.Fprintln implementation is not graphed. HTTP 200 and the exact private-record body evidence its delivery in this guest request only.
The external fmt.Println implementation is not graphed. Its declared marker is observed from the real server in this request only; this does not resolve arbitrary standard-library behavior.
The same guest GET and oracle must produce private data before and explicit HTTP 403 denial after the source change.
The actual guest GET emits the handler marker before the response outcome.

purpose: Compare a synthetic guest GET through the real Go listener and ServeMux under an unchanged supplied harness.
